teaser: You wire up ClaudeAgentOptions, pick a prompt and model, then choose query() or ClaudeSDKClient and watch the stream come back.
takeaways: allowed_tools pre-approves tools; disallowed_tools hard-blocks them, and a deny rule always beats an allow.
A string system_prompt replaces the default; the claude_code preset with append keeps Claude Code guidance and adds your rules.
query() is a one-shot async iterator; ClaudeSDKClient keeps one session across turns and supports interrupt().
Every run ends with a ResultMessage; state is the session's conversation history, not Python variables.
